title: Keto Creamy Mediterranean Stir Fry
description: A keto-friendly stir fry dish made with creamy sauce, Mediterranean flavors, and olive oil. Quick and easy to make.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the sliced zucchini and cook for 2-3 minutes until tender.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 2-3 minutes until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the Mediterranean sauce and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and let cook for 1-2 minutes until heated through.
Stir in the crumbled feta cheese until melted and well combined.
Add the fresh spinach leaves and stir to combine until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
